draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.95, the 157th-best grade among 255 2020 draftees and 23rd of 34 at WR. He went 165th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Auden Tate. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 559 receiving yards in 2019, 30th of 34 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2024. 38 career games and 1 starts over 4 completed seasons. Career-best season: 2 AV in 2020. Weak spots: team target share 0.4% (3rd percentile), receiving yards 6 (3rd percentile). Played 9 of 17 games in 2024.
